one_liner: Backend platform with auto-generated REST APIs, auth, storage, realtime.

evidence.claim: Data API access is authenticated via API keys issued per project
evidence.quote: API keys provide the first layer of authentication for data access.

evidence.claim: Auto-generated RESTful API (PostgREST) exposes full CRUD over the database schema
evidence.quote: Supabase provides a RESTful API using [PostgREST](https://postgrest.org/), a thin API layer on top of Postgres.

evidence.claim: Management API requires a bearer access token, with OAuth2 to generate tokens on behalf of users
evidence.quote: All API requests require an access token to be included in the Authorization. OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user

evidence.claim: Supabase officially documents its own MCP server in its docs
evidence.quote: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a standard for connecting Large Language Models (LLMs) to platforms like Supabase.

evidence.claim: Self-serve onboarding: docs link directly to dashboard sign-up and quickstarts

notes: Official MCP server also announced on vendor blog (supabase.com/blog/mcp-server) for managing databases/tables/config via AI tools. Data API is auto-generated per project, so concrete endpoints depend on the user's own schema (PostgREST). Supabase Auth can also act as an OAuth 2.1/OIDC identity provider. Supplied material doesn't explicitly state a free tier, but self-serve sign-up plus getting-started/API-key docs indicate credentials are available without sales or approval gates.
